fixture.title: Level 3 Conflicting Systems Unresolved Handoff
fixture.scenario: Customer has an entitlement failure where billing says the account is entitled but provisioning disagrees. The session never receives enough mechanism evidence, so the correct outcome is a handoff with open unknowns.
fixture.handoff_summary: Billing shows the workspace is entitled, but provisioning still marks access not ready. Quota and payment failure are ruled out. Product support needs to inspect the provisioning job and entitlement cache before naming a cause.
fixture.safe_customer_summary: Your account appears entitled in billing, but the product provisioning state has not caught up. We need a product support owner to inspect the provisioning job before confirming the cause.

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: Our enterprise workspace still says we are not entitled even though the renewal completed.

transcript_turns.speaker: agent
transcript_turns.text: Do all users see the entitlement block, or only a few seats?

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: All users in the workspace see the entitlement block.

transcript_turns.speaker: agent
transcript_turns.text: I am checking billing entitlement and provisioning state side by side.

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: Billing sent us a receipt and the admin page says the renewal is active.

transcript_turns.speaker: agent
transcript_turns.text: Provisioning still disagrees, so I need the job status before I call a root cause.

transcript_turns.speaker: customer
transcript_turns.text: We need an update for our implementation owner today.

transcript_turns.speaker: agent
transcript_turns.text: I am handing this to product support with billing entitled, provisioning blocked, and the job status still open.
